delta.comment: BLOCKED BY OPEN P1 (F17) — DO NOT EXECUTE AS WRITTEN. This task requires a suite that passes against today's unmodified start.sh across "the same seven dimensions" as the PowerShell suite. That is UNSATISFIABLE: verified against the working tree, start.sh (80 lines) implements only .env.local no-clobber parsing with quote stripping (lines 20-36), a COPILOT_HOME default (54), an unguarded export GITHUB_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)" (56), Copilot exe resolution (57-64), and exec "$copilot_exe" "$@" (66). It has NO ENGRAM_DATA_DIR default (line 55 is commented out), NO GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN handling, and NO COPILOT_USE_REMOTE/--remote logic (zero occurrences each), plus no backlogit sync and no Engram pre-warm. Three of the seven dimensions simply do not exist in start.sh. The upstream plan premise that start.ps1 and start.sh are "two divergent implementations of the same policy" is factually wrong for start.sh, and the same overstated premise underpins the 004-SP PROCEED reconciliation and the composability decision doc. Resolution requires separating shared behavior from PowerShell-only behavior and treating any cross-platform normalization as an explicit behavior change (which S1's zero-behavior-change rule forbids). Raised by PR #325 Copilot review after the 3-cycle budget was exhausted; recorded OPEN and escalated. NOTE: this task is a member of 127-S, so 127-S is NOT safely claimable until F17 is dispositioned. See docs/reviews/... (Cycle 4, F17).
